t: This is the statue of Lord Curzon, a Grade Two listed monument on Carlton House Terrace. It stands opposite Curzon's own home at number one. George Curzon was a statesman, explorer and writer who served as Viceroy of India from 1899 to 1905, and as Foreign Secretary from 1919 to 1924. The sculptor was Bertram Mackennal, an Australian who found great success in Britain. He was the first Australian elected to the Royal Academy, and the first Australian artist to be knighted, in 1921.
